006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IBooleanItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020
021/**
022 * /** Implements <a href=
023 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-deep-equal">fn:deep-equal</a>
024 * functions.
025 * <p>
026 * This implementation does not implement the three-arg variant with collation
027 * at this time.
028 */
029public final class FnDeepEqual {
030  @NonNull
031  private static final String NAME = "deep-equal";
032  @NonNull
033  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_TWO_ARG = IFunction.builder()
034      .name(NAME)
035      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
036      .deterministic()
037      .contextDependent()
038      .focusIndependent()
039      .argument(IArgument.builder()
040          .name("parameter1")
041          .type(IItem.type())
042          .zeroOrMore()
043          .build())
044      .argument(IArgument.builder()
045          .name("parameter2")
046          .type(IItem.type())
047          .zeroOrMore()
048          .build())
049      .returnType(IBooleanItem.type())
050      .returnOne()
051      .functionHandler(FnDeepEqual::executeTwoArg)
052      .build();
053
054  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
055  @NonNull
056  private static ISequence<IBooleanItem> executeTwoArg(@NonNull IFunction function,
057      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
058      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
059      IItem focus) {
060    ISequence<?> parameter1
061        = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
062    ISequence<?> parameter2
063        = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1)));
064
065    // FIXME: support implicit timezone
066    return ISequence.of(
067        IBooleanItem.valueOf(parameter1.deepEquals(parameter2, dynamicContext)));
068  }
069
070  private FnDeepEqual() {
071    // disable construction
072  }
073}
